See what agents and orchestrators are working on, and what recently finished

Usage:
  erun jobs [command]

Available Commands:
  finish      Report a job's progress or its outcome
  list        List jobs: what is being worked on now, and what recently finished
  show        Show one job in full
  start       Record that this actor is starting a piece of work

Flags:
      --erun-alias string   erun platform cloud alias to target (defaults to the sole configured erun-type alias)
  -h, --help                help for jobs

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.

Use "erun jobs [command] --help" for more information about a command.
